title: Secondary Credit
description: We bring extensive experience in secondary credit markets, helping clients source, evaluate, and execute opportunities across distressed, special situations, and off-the-run credits to optimize returns and manage risk.

title: Direct Lending
description: Our team has a proven record in direct lending, structuring and managing bespoke financing solutions for middle-market and large borrowers while balancing yield, covenant protection, and long-term value creation.

title: High Yield
description: With deep insight into the high-yield bond market, we support clients in credit selection, relative-value strategies, and portfolio construction to navigate volatility and capitalize on market dislocations.

title: Equity
description: Our equity expertise spans public and private markets, helping clients identify growth opportunities, assess valuation drivers, and implement disciplined strategies to build enduring equity portfolios.

title: Derivatives
description: We offer seasoned guidance on derivative instruments across asset classes, from plain-vanilla options to complex structures, enabling clients to hedge exposures, enhance yield, or express tactical views.

title: Structured Notes
description: We have deep knowledge of designing, pricing, and managing structured notes that align with investors’ risk profiles and market outlooks, balancing innovation with prudent risk management.

title: ABS & MBS
description: Our team excels in analyzing and managing asset-backed and mortgage-backed securities, evaluating collateral quality, deal structure, and performance metrics to deliver consistent returns.

title: REITs
description: We provide comprehensive insights into real estate investment trusts, helping clients assess property portfolios, market trends, and income potential to build resilient real estate exposure.

title: Swaps
description: We guide clients through the use of interest rate, currency, and credit default swaps, structuring transactions that support hedging objectives and enhance portfolio efficiency.

title: Annuities
description: We bring nuanced understanding of annuity products, from fixed to variable and indexed offerings, assisting clients with product selection, risk evaluation, and integration into broader investment strategies.
